# events.matrix.EventMatrix { #fmrimod.events.matrix.EventMatrix }

```python
EventMatrix(name, onsets, values, durations=0, column_names=None)
```

Multi-column event representation.

This represents events with multiple simultaneous values, such as
multi-dimensional parametric modulators or pre-computed design columns.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type                   | Description                                                    | Default    |
|--------------|------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| name         | str                    | Name of the event                                              | _required_ |
| onsets       | array - like           | Event onset times                                              | _required_ |
| values       | array - like           | Matrix of values, shape (n_events, n_columns)                  | _required_ |
| durations    | scalar or array - like | Event durations. If scalar, used for all events. Default is 0. | `0`        |
| column_names | list of str            | Names for each column. If None, uses generic names.            | `None`     |

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name         | Type        | Description                     |
|--------------|-------------|---------------------------------|
| values       | Array       | Matrix of event values          |
| n_columns    | int         | Number of columns in the matrix |
| column_names | list of str | Names of columns                |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> # Multi-dimensional parametric modulator
>>> event = EventMatrix(
...     name='motion',
...     onsets=[1, 2, 3, 4],
...     values=[[0.1, 0.2, 0.3],
...             [0.2, 0.1, 0.4],
...             [0.3, 0.3, 0.2],
...             [0.1, 0.4, 0.3]],
...     column_names=['x', 'y', 'z']
... )
>>>
>>> # Pre-computed regressors
>>> event = EventMatrix(
...     name='custom',
...     onsets=np.arange(10),
...     values=np.random.randn(10, 3),
...     durations=1.0
... )
```

| Name | Description |

| [apply_transform](#fmrimod.events.matrix.EventMatrix.apply_transform) | Apply transformation to values. |

### apply_transform { #fmrimod.events.matrix.EventMatrix.apply_transform }

```python
apply_transform(transform)
```

Apply transformation to values.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type              | Description                                                                      | Default    |
|-----------|-------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| transform | array or callable | If array, matrix multiply (values @ transform). If callable, apply element-wise. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type        | Description                             |
|--------|-------------|-----------------------------------------|
|        | EventMatrix | New EventMatrix with transformed values |

### design_matrix { #fmrimod.events.matrix.EventMatrix.design_matrix }

```python
design_matrix(sampling_points)
```

Generate design matrix columns for this event.

Creates multiple columns, one for each column in the value matrix.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type   | Description                | Default    |
|-----------------|--------|----------------------------|------------|
| sampling_points | Array  | Time points to evaluate at | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                            |
|--------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------|
|        | Array  | Design matrix columns, shape (n_timepoints, n_columns) |

### from_dataframe { #fmrimod.events.matrix.EventMatrix.from_dataframe }

```python
from_dataframe(
    df,
    name,
    onset_col='onset',
    value_cols=None,
    duration_col='duration',
    **kwargs,
)
```

Create EventMatrix from DataFrame.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type         | Description                                                                           | Default      |
|--------------|--------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| df           | pd.DataFrame | DataFrame containing event data                                                       | _required_   |
| name         | str          | Name for the event                                                                    | _required_   |
| onset_col    | str          | Column name for onsets                                                                | `'onset'`    |
| value_cols   | list of str  | Column names for values. If None, uses all numeric columns except onset and duration. | `None`       |
| duration_col | str          | Column name for durations                                                             | `'duration'` |
| **kwargs     | object       | Additional arguments passed to EventMatrix                                            | `{}`         |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type        | Description              |
|--------|-------------|--------------------------|
|        | EventMatrix | New EventMatrix instance |
